answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the haven of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the forge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The inlet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
